title: Predict the plan before Terraform touches an API
description: Choose a configuration change, decide how resource addresses are preserved, and encode the dependency. The lab separates state identity, data flow, and execution order.

resources.label: Network contract
resources.responsibility: Publishes the upstream identity consumed by the service.

resources.label: Service release
resources.responsibility: Consumes the network identity and represents the deployed service.

resources.label: Smoke check
resources.responsibility: Runs only after the service behavior is ready.

planCases.label: Create a new stack
planCases.summary: Configuration declares all three resource instances, and state has no bindings for them.
planCases.configurationChange: Add network, service, and check resources.
planCases.stateFinding: No prior remote-object identities are bound to these addresses.
planCases.providerBoundary: The provider defines the remote API calls; Terraform Core determines the graph and records successful identities.

planCases.label: Replace an upstream object
planCases.summary: A provider marks one changed network argument as requiring replacement.
planCases.stateFinding: The existing network, service, and check bindings are present.
planCases.providerBoundary: Which arguments update in place or force replacement is provider and resource-type specific.

planCases.label: Rename a resource address
planCases.summary: The service block moves from terraform_data.application to terraform_data.service_release.
planCases.configurationChange: Refactor a configuration address without intending to replace the remote object.
planCases.stateFinding: State still binds the object to terraform_data.application.
planCases.providerBoundary: A moved block changes Terraform's binding before planning; it does not rename the remote object.

stateStrategies.label: Addresses already align
stateStrategies.detail: Configuration and state use the same resource addresses.

stateStrategies.label: Rename without a moved block
stateStrategies.detail: Terraform sees an old address removed and a new address added.

stateStrategies.label: Declare a moved block
stateStrategies.detail: Terraform rebinds the existing object to the new address before planning.

dependencyModes.label: Expression reference
dependencyModes.detail: Pass an upstream attribute into the downstream resource.
dependencyModes.dataFlow: The dependency and the exact value flow are both visible.
dependencyModes.planningEffect: Only values derived from the changing attribute become unknown when Terraform cannot know them until apply.

dependencyModes.label: Explicit depends_on
dependencyModes.detail: Declare a hidden behavioral dependency with no attribute reference.
dependencyModes.dataFlow: Terraform enforces order but receives no downstream input value.
dependencyModes.planningEffect: The plan can be more conservative because Terraform knows less about which upstream value matters.

dependencyModes.label: No dependency
dependencyModes.detail: Declare neither a reference nor depends_on.
dependencyModes.dataFlow: No relationship is present in the graph.
dependencyModes.planningEffect: Independent actions may run in parallel; Terraform cannot infer an external behavioral requirement.
